role: Declares the native explosion (WorldServer.newExplosion minus the packet work: Explosion.doExplosionA and doExplosionB(false)), its result struct, the outside-entity extension hooks and the item-drop sink used under blockcb_env.

structs.name: expl_result
structs.java: Explosion.affectedBlockPositions (HashSet iteration order and insertion order) and Explosion.explosionRNG's final state, for the test

structs.name: expl_extra
structs.java: an Entity outside the run's ie_world seen by the damage pass (posX/Y/Z, getEyeHeight, boundingBox, attackEntityFrom, addVelocity)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 78-85, struct expl_result: affected and affected_first are malloc'd arrays the caller frees
lines 93-102, struct expl_extra and expl_extra_query: function pointers and an opaque void* entity tag (pointer graph)
notes: struct living is forward-declared twice (lines 50 and 57), harmless. The header comment lists what is not ported: non-null exploder resistance, the players' knockback map, S27PacketExplosion and the affected-position clear.
